user.title: Sun Sweep
user.description: Draw today's sun angles around your house. With House Structure, that house is the OpenStreetMap outline. Without it, the card draws a 10 m square. The card on the dashboard chooses the sun, the moon, the times, the hour lines and the twilight.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Sun Sweep is already set up.
abort.no_outline: House Structure has no building outline for this home yet. Set House Structure up at this home, where OpenStreetMap has the building, and try again.
